notes: VAT standard rate 15% (VAT Act Fourth Schedule; MRA guide). Bullion EXEMPT (not zero-rated): the First Schedule (exempt goods) item 52(b) covers gold unwrought/semi-manufactured/powder of heading 71.08; finished jewellery (7113) is not listed. Silver bullion likewise EXEMPT (item 57, heading 71.06); silver jewellery 15%. Duty null (no openable official 7108 line).

sources.name: Value Added Tax Act (Attorney-General's Office, Revised Laws of Mauritius), First Schedule item 52 and Fourth Schedule
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the rate of VAT is 15 per cent, and the First Schedule of exempt goods covers gold, unwrought or in semi-manufactured forms, or in powder form, of heading 71.08
sources.quote: (b) Gold, unwrought or in semi-manufactured forms, or in powder form, or waste and scrap of heading No. 71.08.
